full-anatomy.note: Every region switched on — the complete anatomy. The reference; real pages are subsets of this.

anatomy-soft.note: The same anatomy, no dark band — the page header steps down to a branded-gray strip, the rest stays canvas. The calm, all-light emphasis.

anatomy-paneled.note: The same anatomy with the side rails shaded (secondary) — soft branded-gray panels framing the white content. Figure/ground from shade, not lines.

anatomy-framed.note: The same anatomy with the accent moved down — page header recedes to gray, the main header wears the strong band (primary). The dark surface sits over the content.

content.note: Header + main. A titled page with scrolling content — the everyday page (a list, a record, a feed).

content-nav.note: Header + a left sidebar + main. A section that carries its own navigation — settings, docs, an admin area.

content-panel.note: Header + main + a context panel on the right. A record beside its properties, activity or help.

focus.note: Centered content, no header — a single focused thing. Dashboard welcome, an empty state, a confirmation.

auth.note: No app chrome, a centered card. Sign in, sign up, onboarding — anything reached before the shell.

stack.note: The auto-layout primitive on its own: direction, hug/fill/fixed, nesting, wrap. Cells are Card. Patterns compose with it — this is the primitive itself.
